label: Atmosphere
help: Place the ground surface with this entity's Transform. Select a directional light as the Sun.

properties.label: Preset
properties.help: Spherical clear atmosphere with Earth-like molecules, aerosols and ozone.

properties.label: Sun
properties.help: Bind an existing directional light. An empty or missing reference uses the ordinary background.

properties.label: Sun Disk Radius
properties.help: How large the Sun's disk looks in the sky, as an angle from its centre to its edge. The default matches the real Sun. Only a Sun with an authored direction uses it; the Earth Sun preset sets its own size, so this field is hidden then.

properties.label: Night sky
properties.help: Show stars beyond the atmosphere. A linked Earth celestial driver adds the Milky Way and visible planets for its date and observer location.

properties.label: Moon
properties.help: Bind a different directional light to the optional lunar disk. Its Transform or celestial driver sets the direction.

properties.label: Northern lights
properties.help: Draw auroral curtains toward this entity's local +Z direction. Use a perspective camera and look low in the night sky.

properties.label: Aurora emission
properties.help: Peak brightness added per metre through a curtain. Zero hides the layer.

properties.label: Aurora time
properties.help: Preview a moment in the 120-second loop. Play starts the animation here.

properties.label: Cloud layer
properties.help: Draw one bounded, flat cloud slab centred on this entity, lit by the Sun. It does not yet shade the ground.

properties.label: Cloud base
properties.help: Height of the cloud's flat underside above this entity's ground plane.

properties.label: Cloud thickness
properties.help: Distance from the cloud's underside to its top.

properties.label: Cloud size X
properties.help: Width of the cloud along this entity's local X axis.

properties.label: Cloud size Z
properties.help: Width of the cloud along this entity's local Z axis.

properties.label: Cloud edge fade
properties.help: Distance over which the cloud thins out to nothing at its sides. Zero draws sharp sides.

properties.label: Cloud density
properties.help: Multiplies the cloud extinction. Zero is an empty layer that draws the clear sky.

properties.label: Cloud extinction
properties.help: Fraction of light the cloud removes per metre at density one. The default makes a 1000 m thick cloud let through about 2% of the light behind it.

properties.label: Cloud albedo
properties.help: Fraction of removed light that the cloud scatters rather than absorbs. Zero is a dark absorber.

properties.label: Cloud forward scattering
properties.help: Henyey-Greenstein asymmetry. Zero scatters evenly in every direction; positive values brighten the cloud around the Sun.
